text:
leo_fin: Heads up  MarketWave submitted a dispute TKT-9987. They say a partner onboarding promo (EXP_PARTNER_30) wasn't applied to May invoice 81234. Asking for a manual credit + corrected invoice.

natalie_csm: oh no. sales notes say partner experiment gives 30% off total reserved+usage for first month. did they provide the promo token?

leo_fin: sales wrote it in the deal: 'EXP_PARTNER_30 applied on signup'. invoice excerpt:
```
Invoice 81234
- Reserved pool (MW-RESV): $9,000
- Usage overage (MW-USG): $2,500
- Discounts: $0 (expected EXP_PARTNER_30 -> 30%)
Total: $11,500
```

sam_billing: need clarity: was discount on reserved only or entire invoice? if entire invoice, expected credit = $3,450.

natalie_csm: confirmed with AE: 30% on full invoice for month 1. expected net = $8,050.

cfo_mike: good to make whole; preserving partner relationship matters. GL to use?

sam_billing: GL code = 5115 (Partner/Promo Adjustments). i'll prepare credit memo and reissue invoice 81234-R1. tag reason: "EXP_PARTNER_30_MAY_ADJ".

cfo_mike: approved. add short justification: "Partner onboarding experiment not applied; customer dispute TKT-9987." :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0068 created for $3,450. Reissued invoice 81234-R1 (net due $8,050). PDF: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/81234-R1

sam_billing: emailed credit memo and corrected invoice to MarketWave; copied sales and CS. Logging note to require explicit promo token in billing cutoff checklist.

leo_fin: thanks. putting a quick retro item for pricing-experiments board so engineering surfaces promo flags to billing earlier. closing once MarketWave ackns.
